title.narrative: Program to Support Transparency and Integrity Reforms in Argentina
Programa de Apoyo a Reformas de Transparencia e Integridad en Argentina

description.narrative: El objetivo del programa es contribuir a la transparencia e integridad mediante regulaciones y mecanismos que promuevan el acceso a la informacin en las siguientes materias: (i) la adopcin con rango legal del principio de acceso a la informacin pblica y la conducta tica de los funcionarios pblicos; (ii) la gestin del gasto en obras, contrataciones y personal del Estado; y (iii) la gestin del sector financiero.

The objective of the program is to contribute to transparency and integrity through regulations and mechanisms that promote access to information in the following areas: (i) legal adoption of the principle of access to public information and ethical conduct of officials Public services; (Ii) the management of expenditure on works, contracting and government personnel; And (iii) management of the financial sector.
